scripts.build: npm run check && electron-vite build --config config/electron.vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p config/typescript/tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p config/typescript/tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p config/typescript/tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p config/typescript/tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --config config/oxlint.config.ts --tsconfig config/typescript/tsconfig.tools.json --deny-warnings src config tests
scripts.format: oxfmt --config config/oxfmt.json --write src config tests package.json tsconfig.json README.md "!src/renderer/shared/theme/tokens.*"
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --config config/oxfmt.json --check src config tests package.json tsconfig.json README.md "!src/renderer/shared/theme/tokens.*"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run tokens:check && npm run test:tooling
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config config/playwright.config.ts
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.json --dir --publish never
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.package:mac:unsigned: npm run build && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.json --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:signed: npm run build && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.signed.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:unsigned: npm run build && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.json --win --x64 --publish never
